translations.web: “Woe to the shepherds who destroy and scatter the sheep of my pasture!” says Yahweh.
translations.bsb: “Woe to the shepherds who destroy and scatter the sheep of My pasture!” declares the LORD.
translations.kjv: Woe be unto the pastors that destroy and scatter the sheep of my pasture! saith the LORD.
translations.asv: Woe unto the shepherds that destroy and scatter the sheep of my pasture! saith Jehovah.
